{{Quote|We have a set of secret accounts on the planet Muunilinst.|General Jan Dodonna|<ref name="Rebel Force: Target" />}}
The '''Mission to Muunilinst''' was the assignment to recover the financial assets of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]].

==Prelude==
With [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] destroyed, a large percentage of the Rebellion's monetary funds were eradicated. Fortunately, a portion of the wealth was deposited on the banking [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Muunilinst. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] entrusted [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to retrieve the [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] containing their financial access codes. Together with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companions, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], they were to make contact with [[Mak Luunim]] and recover the reserves. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] volunteered to transport the party to Muunilinst.

==The Mission==
The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] made the [[jump]] from [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] to the [[Muunilinst system/Legends|Muunilinst system]], and was immediately assaulted on [[Reversion/Legends|reversion]]. Experiencing a failure with the offensive weaponry, the ''Falcon'' was at the mercy of its attacker, a single [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]]. A [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighter]] came to the aid of the ''Falcon'', and destroyed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]]. In the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|conflict]], the ''Preybird'' was damaged, and made an emergency landing on one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of Muunilinst. Feeling an obligation to aid their [[X-7|rescuer]], the crew of the ''Millennium Falcon'' followed him down. They followed a [[Blood/Legends|blood]] trail to a cave, where they found a badly wounded man who introduced himself as [[X-7|Tobin Elad]]. While trying to help the man, the resident of the cave returned home. The [[Reek/Legends|reek]] detected intruders and immediately attacked. In a moment of ill-advised [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, Han Solo collapsed the entrance to the underground chamber while killing the beast. Realizing that time was a factor for the survival of Elad, Luke employed his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to bore a hole in the landslide, and liberated the party.

[[File:Muun.jpg|thumb|left|100px|A [[Muun/Legends|Muun]].]]

After nursing the wounded man back to health, the crew determined he could be an asset on their mission, so they made [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#P|planetfall]] on Muunilinst to continue their task. Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Chewbacca and Tobin Elad went to [[Mak Luunim's apartment]] in search of the Muun. They were greeted by [[Mak Luunim's employee|employee]], who informed the Rebels that his master has recently passed away. While they questioned the employee, six [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] appeared behind the Rebels and blocked the room's only exit. The stormtroopers tried to detain the Rebels but Solo and X-7 launched a surprise attack on the stormtroopers, culminating into a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster]] shootout in the room. Fighting their way to freedom, the Rebels were able to shoot down three of the stormtroopers before making their escape without any casualties. The party made their way to the fringes of [[Pilaan]] and entered a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the outskirts of the city in the hope of uncovering information to complete their assignment.

In the cantina, they discovered that Luunim owed many individuals money, especially a well respected [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] known as [[Nal Kenuun]]. When the party heard that Keenun had been to Mak Luumin's abode, they assumed the datacard was in his possession. The rebels needed to contact Nal Keenuun. After leaving the cantina, the crew encountered a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]], introducing himself as [[Grunta]]. He had overheard that they were looking for Keenum and offered to take them to him. On the way, he and his three companions ambushed Leia and her associates, trying to earn a few [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the hard way! A [[Lightfight|melee]] ensued in which Grunta was killed, and the three remaining Dugs retreated. At that time, a squad of stormtroopers, using [[Poison dart/Legends|poison darts]], arrived to apprehend the rebels.

The party awoke to find themselves captors of the Muun they were seeking, Nal Keenum. They learned that Keenum held the datacard they sought. Unfortunately, the Dug they eliminated was an employee of Keenum's, and was the favorite to win the [[Podracing/Legends|Podrace]] two days hence. In order to retrieve their property, the rebels had to replace the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] they terminated, ''and'' win the race in order to recover the missing datacard. Not knowing what to do, Luke blindly offered to take the place of the Dug.

====The Podrace====
{{Quote|… no human can win a podrace. The best of human pilots would be lucky to even finish the race without crashing.|Tobin Elad|<ref name="Rebel Force: Target" />}}
The day before the podrace, Luke Skywalker was permitted to make a practice run in the pod vacated by Grunta, a [[Plug-2 Behemoth]] manufactured by [[Collor Pondrat/Legends|Collor Pondrat]]. Unfortunately, due to a defective current filter, one of the pod's engines overheated and ''flamed-out'', causing it to enter an uncontrollable spin. Luke had to eject and allow the pod to crash, destroying it for the race. The young pilot returned to his tent to mend his wounds and study maps of the race circuit, while Leia and Elad petitioned Kenuun to relinquish another of his many podracers, so Luke could practice. They were able to attain a [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]] [[9T9-B Wasp/Legends|KV9T9-B Wasp]] in time for Skywalker to make a practice run the same afternoon.

On the day of the race, Leia Organa attempted to dissuade Luke from entering the race, but he was determined to start. He realized he would not be able to compete without the aid of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Not allowing thoughts to become a factor, young Skywalker ''felt'' his way around the course, He entered the first leg of the race with confidence, negotiating the paths of the narrow gorge, passing two other pods and setting his sights on the leader.

The second leg wound through a labyrinthine network of underground caves and tunnels, known as [[Aliuun Gorge]], ending in a near ninety degree climb. Luke gained on his competition, as he exited the ravine, and embarked on the final leg of the race. Entering the wide plains for the final straightaway, the novice podracer challenged the [[Bin Gassi Racing Engines|Bin Gassi]] for the lead. The [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] piloting the pod veered to block his young challenger and careened out of control, allowing the ''Wasp'' to make the pass and assume the lead. Luke Skywalker maintained his advantage and won the race, making the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[X-7]], posing as Tobin Elad, wonder if the young rebel was in fact the pilot who destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], and the one whom he was sent to eliminate.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I have ''[seen something like it]''. Though not since that kid back on Tatooine. You're all too young to remember—but I'll never forget. That was something.|Grizzled [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]]|<ref name="Rebel Force: Target" />}}
Back at Kennun's home after the victory, Han, Luke, and Tobin Elad were granted the datacard as promised. However, Nal Keenun discovered the bounties placed on the heads of Han Solo and Tobin Elad and refused to let a profit slip past. After a standoff trying to arrest the pair, Elad said he would gladly go with the Muun if he agreed to let his friends go free. It was then that Leia entered with the pet [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]], belonging to Nal Keenun, threatening the goodwill of the serpent. Seeing no other option, Keenun was forced to see the Rebels safely off planet.

On the ''Millennium Falcon'' after lift-off, Leia Organa confided in Elad, and invited him to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebellion]]. After this meeting, he contacted his [[Rezi Soresh|master]], informing him that his ''Target'' may be Luke Skywalker, due to his surprising victory in the podrace.
